# Health insurance deductible

Javier's Bupa By You cover through the language academy, from January 2025. Membership 8420-KJ-1176-03. Just him, not me or the kids (adding us would be £212 a month, no).

## The excess, which Bupa calls the excess and the Americans call a deductible

- **£250 per person per scheme year**, scheme year runs 1 Jan to 31 Dec
- Paid once per year, not per claim. The first £250 of eligible treatment in the year is on him, after that Bupa pays in full up to the limits
- Outpatient limit: £1,000 a year (consultations, scans, physio)
- In-patient and day-patient: unlimited, at hospitals on the Bupa "Essential Access" list. Spire Leeds and Nuffield Leeds both on it

## First use: his back, February 2025

- GP referral 4 Feb (needed, Bupa won't authorise without one)
- Pre-authorisation call 5 Feb, ref BUPA-PA-552018
- Consultant: Mr Anand Rao, orthopaedics, Spire Leeds, 12 Feb. £220
- MRI lumbar spine, 14 Feb: £495
- Physio, 6 sessions at Nuffield, £65 each = £390

Total £1,105. Javier paid the first £250 (consultant invoice, then £30 toward the MRI). Bupa paid £855, but the outpatient cap of £1,000 is now nearly used: £855 spent, £145 left for the rest of 2025. More physio after that is on us. His exercises are in [[Lower back pain]].

## Tax side

Employer-paid medical cover is a benefit in kind. The academy pays £58 a month for him, so £696 for the year goes on his P11D and reduces his tax code. The academy first reported the wrong figure, sorted in [[Tax code letters]]. At 20% it costs him £139.20 in tax for cover worth far more.

## What isn't covered

- Dental: no. That's all NHS band charges for us, see [[Dentist visit notes]]
- Pre-existing: moratorium underwriting, anything he had symptoms of in the last 5 years is excluded for the first 2 years. The back was new (Dec 2024 onwards) so fine
- Chronic conditions: never

## Comparison with Japan

Claire's husband Kenji's policy in Fukuoka works on a totally different basis, with a daily hospital allowance rather than an excess. Notes in [[医療保険の見直し]].
